IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, light blonde
hair and a hair clip wears a pale blue crinkle-texture
zip shirt with a pointed collar and small heart pulls,
layered over a white pleated mini skirt with two
black belts. A silver pendant necklace and a clear
pearl choker complete the look. Her expression is
calm. A casting board and a dark curtain behind
her. Palette of powder blue, white, and black. Soft
and playful, in the style of a behind-the-scenes Y2K
lookbook.
